scan_cache_dir: scan the HuggingFace cache directory and return an HFCacheInfo structure with repo details
delete_revisions: delete cached revisions by commit hash and return a DeleteCacheStrategy for dry-run or execution
export_as_table: export HFCacheInfo as a formatted table string with optional verbosity for repo or revision detail
execute_delete_strategy: execute a DeleteCacheStrategy to remove cached blobs, refs, snapshots, and repos in safe order
scan_single_repo: scan a single cached repo path and return a CachedRepoInfo with revisions, files, and size info
